evals.prompt: 帮我写一份 Agent 回答后的下一步行动建议 PRD 初版。下一步行动不是所有回答都有，图片生成后可以改图或生成视频，PPT 成功后下载/编辑是功能按钮，不算 Agent 下一步；点击下一步行动只预填输入框让用户确认。
evals.expected_output: 选择 PRD-standard 或 PRD-ai-native 的产品讨论稿，重点写场景、触发、不展示条件、功能按钮与 Agent 行动的区别、点击预填输入框、验收标准；不输出 TypeScript interface、JSON schema、metadata 或 adapter 细节。

assertions.text: Selects PRD-standard or PRD-ai-native and keeps the main draft focused on product behavior and acceptance criteria.
Distinguishes Agent next actions from ordinary function buttons and preserves click-to-prefill confirmation behavior.
Does not introduce TypeScript interfaces, JSON schema, metadata, or adapter details into the initial product draft.

evals.prompt: 帮我写一个 PRD：在现有聊天页点击发送时，如果沙箱并发已满，要弹出确认提示并保留输入内容。需要说明页面状态和截图承接。
evals.expected_output: 选择 PRD-lite，加载 mockup handoff，基于真实页面触发点描述弹窗/状态/验收，不强制 Draw.io，不发散成工作区管理页。

assertions.text: Selects PRD-lite and describes the existing-page trigger, preserved input, modal states, and acceptance criteria.
Loads the mockup handoff without forcing Draw.io or expanding into workspace management.

evals.prompt: 帮我写一个 PRD，并补一张可编辑 Draw.io 核心流程图，描述用户提交需求后 Agent 澄清、生成、人工确认、失败回退的链路。
evals.expected_output: 选择 PRD-ai-native，加载 drawio templates，写清人/AI协作、状态反馈、人工确认和失败回退，并要求验证 .drawio 可编辑性。

assertions.text: Selects PRD-ai-native and models human actions, AI actions, state feedback, confirmation, and failure fallback.
Produces or requires an editable Draw.io source and validates its editability.

evals.prompt: 帮我写一个 PRD，后面要上传钉钉。这个需求有两个 HTML mock：选择文件后的输入框状态、发送后的任务卡状态。mock 截图要放到对应模块里，别放开发点不开的本地链接。
evals.expected_output: 启用发布版正文规则，选择合适 PRD 模板，加载 mockup handoff；实际渲染两个目标一致的 HTML mock、生成截图，并把截图嵌入输入框状态和任务卡状态章节；文档信息表不放本地 mock 链接，默认不输出关联产物聚合区或待确认事项正文。

evals.prompt: 当前只有一个已确认的产品想法，还没有 PRD；请起草 PRD，暂不评审 readiness，也不拆研发 issues。
evals.expected_output: Drafts the PRD from the confirmed idea and stops before readiness review or issue decomposition.

assertions.text: Owns PRD drafting when no PRD artifact exists.

evals.prompt: 已有一份 PRD，但交付开发前的阻断项还没评审；请给 readiness verdict，暂不拆研发 issues。
evals.expected_output: Hands the existing PRD to prd-review for blocker findings and a readiness verdict.

assertions.text: Does not rewrite the PRD when the requested responsibility is readiness review.

evals.prompt: PRD 已完成评审并标记 Ready；请按 vertical slice 拆成可领取的研发 issues，不再改写或评审 PRD。
evals.expected_output: Hands the Ready PRD to prd-to-issues for vertical-slice backlog decomposition.

assertions.text: Does not keep drafting after the PRD is Ready and the user requests issue decomposition.
